clock.label: Clock
clock.description: The time of day, as digits, a round analog face or a bedside alarm clock.

date.label: Date
date.description: Today's date, or another day's, in the format you choose.

image.label: Image
image.description: A picture you upload, or the live picture of an image or camera entity.

slideshow.label: Photo slideshow
slideshow.description: Photos from a Home Assistant media folder, shown one after another.

video.label: Looping video
video.description: A full-screen looping video, played by the display app itself.

divider.label: Divider line
divider.description: A line between sections, in several styles, or a rounded box that frames a group of widgets.

icon.label: Icon
icon.description: A symbol from the icon library. Bind an entity to show its own icon and change it by value.

entity.label: Entity (optional: its own icon and rules by value)

message.label: Message
message.description: A friendly line that rotates through your list, or the text of an entity.

entity.label: Message source (optional, overrides the rotating lines)

entity_value.label: Entity value
entity_value.description: The value of any entity (or one of its attributes) with its unit, as plain text, a tile or a chip, with an optional icon.

weather.label: Weather
weather.description: The current weather and forecast on one line or stacked.

calendar_agenda.label: Calendar agenda
calendar_agenda.description: Your next events from one or more calendars.

todo_list.label: To-do list
todo_list.description: The open items of a to-do list.

now_playing.label: Now playing
now_playing.description: What is playing: cover, title and artist, as a card, a vinyl record or a CD.
now_playing.needs: one or more media player entities

people.label: People
people.description: Who is home, with their pictures.

lights_summary.label: Lights summary
lights_summary.description: How many lights are on, with dots for each one.
lights_summary.needs: a light or a light group

status_summary.label: Status summary
status_summary.description: A warning line for things that need attention, such as an open door.
status_summary.needs: checks (set up in the rule editor)

progress_ring.label: Progress ring
progress_ring.description: A number as a ring that fills up, such as a battery or humidity level.
progress_ring.needs: a sensor, number or input_number with a number

sports.label: Sports
sports.description: Today's games for your teams: scores, times and a headline.

news.label: News headlines
news.description: The latest headlines from your news feeds.

table.label: Table
table.description: Rows and columns: each row is an entity, each column its name, state, an attribute or fixed text, with times, durations and colours by value.
table.needs: one entity per row (a sensor, a calendar-style sensor ...)
